column1: # Hacks that are legitimately sparse: thin line art, a grid, or a chart on a black
# field. Columns (tab separated): id, tile floor, reason. Consumed by test gates
# only; hacks.tsv keeps its four columns because the chooser plugin requires exactly four.
# Criterion for a listed hack: healthy (alive, clean exit) AND moving AND not black AND
# lit-tile coverage >= its floor, measured the same way as the 15 percent pixel gate
# (grim -s 0.125, 8x8 tiles, channel > 16). Floors sit at or under the measured minimum
# over a run (see docs/SPARSE-HACKS.md) and far above an empty frame, which scores 0.
